notes.title: Check out our friend's first indie game - Starseed
notes.content:
Hey there


A company we are closely allied with, are working on their first game. Please take some time to check it out and maybe wishlist it if you like it.


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1263170/Starseed/

This is Starseed


Starseed is a crafting, farm sim based on finding out if a newly discovered planet can be made habitable. 

"A farm sim with dark undertones and an isolated atmosphere"

The world is in chaos! Humans have ruthlessly sucked the life out of Earth. We face horrible consequences. Trained for space travel for a daunting mission of finding out if a newly discovered planet can be made habitable. 



Features:

Start by naming the new planet - you are the first inhabitant after all.


    Exploration
     Researching
     Crafting
     Side Missions
     Procedural Generation  


         And many more


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/12158146/c8ee04e6c915c85634b3a1f2bc5424fc35efa3ac.png



Thanks for your time. Check it out and wishlist if you are interested


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1263170/Starseed/

notes.title: New Update(15 May 2016)
notes.content:
Hey guys

So I've been recieving quite a few requests from you all, and I've done my best to fix/improve some of the things:

Thank you to the followibng users for reporting the issues or suggesting the improvements: Nax_o, SlaterDies

Fixes:
1. Naming a save file with 'r' in it's name no longer activates the recording.

Improvements:
1. There is now a 'CLEAR' button to instantly clear all sound nodes.
2. Sound nodes now appear in center of screen instead behind spawn button.
3. Updated to a later Unity version, I've noticed better loading time, however I doubt this would be the case on all machines.

ːASMRUniverseː

press '8' for duck

Please vote for The Housewife at:

The Housewife is a parable on spouse abuse. The story follows a day in the life of an unnamed housewife and her every desire to please her husband. She lives and illusioned life and has forgotten the world outside her husband, kids and home.

notes.title: New update released
notes.content:
Thanks for being patient. I really appreciate all your feedback and support.ːsteamhappyː

New Features:

    More sounds as requested by the community
    Ability to record and export sounds as wav files. Press 'r' and you'll see a red light go on, press it again and red light will go off and the recording will stop and will be saved in the game install folder(normally something like: ...\SteamGames\steamapps\common\ASMR Universe or right click the app in steam and choose 'browse local content').
    slight performance and visual improvements
 

Thanks again and enjoy

notes.title: New update coming soon.
notes.content:
So the update is nearly completed, but due to my horrible internet, I really struggle to get it on Steam. So no concrete date can be given. Expect it within the next 1-4weeks.

New features:
-You can now record sounds. Pressing 'r' will record all sounds in your space and pressing 'r' again saves the file as a wav.

-New sounds(fan sounds as suggested by Florence, bird sounds as suggested by Boots, and more)

-Minor visual changes and performance optimizations
